subject: Future Tech
title: Google's Supremacy Claim
description: A fast breakdown of Google's Supremacy Claim for builders.

hook.text: In 2019, Google announced quantum supremacy. Their Sycamore chip solved a problem in just 200 seconds.

buildup.text: Google claimed a classical supercomputer would need 10,000 years for the same task. The world took notice.

discovery.text: The task was sampling random quantum circuits, chosen specifically to favor a quantum machine over classical.

twist.text: IBM pushed back, arguing a classical machine with enough memory could finish in days, not ten millennia.

climax.text: Debate aside, Sycamore proved a quantum chip could outperform classical hardware on at least one real task.

punchline.text: Supremacy was a milestone, not the finish line.

quiz.question: What was Google's quantum supremacy chip called?
